title: Squares of a sorted slice
prompt:
Write `SortedSquares(nums []int) []int`. `nums` is sorted ascending and may contain negatives. Return the squares sorted ascending in O(n), without sorting.

`[-7 -3 0 2 5]` → `[0 4 9 25 49]`. An empty slice gives an empty slice.
hint: The biggest square is at one of the two ends, so fill the result from the back with two pointers.
